reason: The cited evidence shows MTPs can be actively learned for refractory alloys (E1, E2) and achieve near-DFT accuracy for energies/forces (E3), but none of the passages address high-temperature free energies, vibrational entropy, anharmonic corrections, or fusion properties. The key premises about capturing entropy, anharmonicity, and outperforming TOR-TILD are unsupported by the cited evidence.
premises: Active learning can identify extrapolative configurations from sparse high-temperature training sets for MTPs.
MTPs can encode local atomic environments sensitive to structural order and anharmonic vibrational effects.
Perturbative corrections can be incorporated into MTPs to capture vibrational entropy and anharmonicity.
The proposed workflow will be faster than TOR-TILD for elemental/binary systems near fusion.
The method will yield phase free energies and melting observables with accuracy nearly matching explicit AIMD.
